_help: VULPHEX's brains. Big fast models run in the CLOUD (NVIDIA, Gemini) — no download, only called during training/chat, so it is never slow. The uncensored model is for when a task needs no refusals; it runs local/Kaggle (NVIDIA hosts no abliterated model). The router picks one per job. Keys come from the environment (NVIDIA_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY); in Mark's cloud session they are already connected.
